messages:
Maya (oncall): alert: high tail latency for dedicated-pool-us-west-2, noticing 95th jump ~11:12 UTC :warning:
Elena: seeing CPU+GPU slot saturation on pool d-pool-west-2, a bunch of tenants pinned to same hosts
Jon (runtime): initial profiler shows kernel selection flip to fallback_kernel_v2 under memory pressure, huge perf delta
Sam (perf): attaching quick trace (short):
```
95th: 420ms -> 1800ms
kernel: aten_fast -> fallback_kernel_v2 (at 11:08)
batch_size distribution: p50=4 p95=64 p99=128
KV cache hitrate: 74% -> 28% for tenant T-493
```
Maya (oncall): @Jon @Elena prioritize mitigations, this is impacting SLAs for three enterprise customers
Elena: autoscaler didn't respect "isolation_tags" for reserved_quota; we packed tenants when we should've spread them. opening placement rollback now
autoscale-bot: triggered scale-up: +6 nodes (requested) -> pending due to quota caps
Jon (runtime): hypothesis: noisy neighbor (T-493) causes KV thrash -> working set spill -> kernel selector falls back to safer but slower kernels; also batching heuristic created large batches at tail
Sam (perf): verified KV miss heatmap: T-493 has 5x write-through invalidations; appears to be using short-lived contexts causing no prefix cache reuse
Maya (oncall): immediate mitigation proposed:
- throttle T-493 QPS by 40%
- enable kernel_override=prefer_fast on impacted nodes
- reduce batch_size_max from 128 -> 32 for d-pool-west-2
- force placement policy to respect isolation_tags
Jon (runtime): I can push kernel_override to the pool now (hotfix), will also add a metric to track kernel_switch_rate
Elena: increasing reserved_quota for enterprise tier to unblock autoscaler, doing it now
autoscale-bot: scale-up completed: +6 nodes online (11:34 UTC) :white_check_mark:
Sam (perf): after throttle+override p95 dropped to ~480ms, KV hitrate for T-493 improved to 63%
Jon (runtime): rolled kernel_override and batch_size limit, also patched batching heuristic to avoid combining requests from different tenants into same batch if soft_affinity enabled
Elena: placement change applied, new allocations split noisy tenants across more hosts
Maya (oncall): marking incident as triaged, still monitoring for 30m. owners: Jon (runtime) for fix, Elena (dedicated) for placement + quotas, Sam for postmortem perf analysis
Jon (runtime): follow-up items:
- add guard in kernel selector to prefer quantized kernel when memory pressure detected
- add KV namespace autosizing heuristic to reduce miss storms
- add e2e test for batch_shuffling with soft_affinity
Sam (perf): I'll produce a perf runbook and a short regression test set to add to Redwood Optimize
Maya (oncall): great. postmortem template will be assigned. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Jon (runtime): quick log excerpt for posterity:
```
[11:07:59] kernel_selector: chose fallback_kernel_v2 reason=mem_pressure score=0.12
[11:08:03] batcher: combined 96 reqs from 4 tenants -> latency spike
[11:08:05] kv_cache: miss_rate tenant=T-493 window=60s rate=0.72
```
Elena: ETA for closing incident: 3h to confirm stable and roll permanent config.
Maya (oncall): noted, will keep channel updates minimal, escalate if p95 > 700ms again.
